== Biography ==
Samuel Glasgow was born about 1844, the son of [[Glasgow-1049|Robert Glasgow]] and [[Dunseeth-1|Margret Unknown]].

=== Name and birth date ===

Samuel appears with his family in the surviving 1851 census material for Danbought, Dunaghy, County Antrim. A published transcription renders his given name as '''Samuel'''.<ref>[http://www.searchforancestors.com/locality/ireland/census1851/dunaghy.html Search for Ancestors: 1851 Census, Dunaghy]</ref>

The original census image is somewhat ambiguous and the name could potentially be read as ''Daniel''. Samuel was therefore previously recorded under that name. However, the identification as '''Samuel''' is supported by his later gravestone, and Samuel also fits the naming pattern of the wider Glasgow family better than Daniel.

The census age suggests a birth around 1844. His grave memorial implies a birth approximately three years earlier.<ref>[https://www.findagrave.com/memorial/9002893/samuel-glasgow Find a Grave Memorial 9002893: Samuel Glasgow]</ref> A discrepancy of a few years between nineteenth-century census ages and later memorial information is not unusual, so the evidence presently favours these records referring to the same Samuel Glasgow.

=== Family ===

Samuel married '''Martha Ann Edsel''', who lived from 1842 to 1933.<ref name="FAG">[https://www.findagrave.com/memorial/9002893/samuel-glasgow Find a Grave Memorial 9002893: Samuel Glasgow]</ref>

Children attributed to Samuel and Martha include:<ref name="FAG" />

* '''William J. Glasgow''' (1865–1944)
* '''Robert J. Glasgow''' (1867–1946)
* '''Margaret Jane Glasgow''', later Fisher (1869–1951)
* '''Catherine E. Glasgow''', later Reece (1873–1950)
* '''James Morton Glasgow''' (1876–1942)
* '''Anna M. Glasgow''', later George (1877–1949)
* '''George Jarold Glasgow''' (1880–1949)
* '''Albert Glasgow''' (1882–1958)
* '''Edward C. Glasgow''' (1886–1976)

His known sister was '''Margret Ann Glasgow''', later Wylie (1837–1899).

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1049]] is assessed at 96% (proved). The held 1851 Donbought transcription identifies Daniel Glasgow as a child of head Robert, with wife Margaret and their 1833 marriage. The seven-year-old son’s name is disputed Daniel/Samuel; this does not undermine his relationship to the household head.

Confidence concerns this recorded child and the selected father as identified by the held family evidence; maternity and the father’s upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Compare the full original 1851 return with both transcriptions, including relationship headings.

Source basis already held: [http://www.census.nationalarchives.ie/pages/1851/Antrim/Kilconway/Dunaghy/Donbought/16/ National Archives of Ireland, legacy household locator]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.



The child's given name in the 1851 census should be treated with some caution. The online transcription reads ''Samuel'', while the handwriting in the original record is not entirely clear and has previously been interpreted as ''Daniel''. Later evidence identifying him as Samuel makes that reading the stronger interpretation unless further contemporary records establish otherwise.

The precise year of Samuel's birth also remains uncertain. His census age points to about 1844, while the grave information suggests a birth roughly three years earlier.
